summary: Full regression after backend modularization (server.py -> core.py + models.py + routes/*.py) and new admin real-time ALERTS. All 32 pytest tests pass. Frontend e2e validates: admin sound toggle activates and shows toast 'Alertas de sonido activadas'; creating an order via API while admin dashboard is open triggers toast 'Nuevo pedido recibido (total: N)' AND adds an entry with data-testid alert-item-order to 'Alertas recientes'; customer AI smart search 'tengo hambre' returns smart-search-results. Backend idle_count top-level field plus per-live-driver idle/idle_seconds fields are present on /api/admin/active-drivers (idle bee can't be triggered live without a stale WebSocket location, but the computation/fields exist).

issues: Google Maps 'Oops! Something went wrong.' overlay continues to show because REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is the placeholder 'YOUR_API_KEY_HERE' (expected per main agent). Consider a friendlier fallback UI until a real key is provided.

action_items: (Optional, code review) Some routes still validate body before role check, so non-business users hitting POST /api/products with an incomplete payload get 422 (e.g., missing image_url) instead of 403. Consider making Product image_url optional or doing role-check before pydantic body coercion. Not a regression.
(Optional) Replace Google Maps error block with a friendlier placeholder until a real REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is configured.
critical_code_review_comments: Modularization is clean: server.py is now ~75 lines and mounts 11 routers; core.py centralizes db/auth/manager. Good split.
routes/admin.py correctly computes idle_seconds with tz-aware datetimes and exposes top-level idle_count + per-live-driver idle/idle_seconds. Threshold 90s as specified.
Public /api/auth/register still rejects role='admin' with 400 after refactor.
WebSocket /ws/tracking/{order_id} is kept on the app (not the /api router) which is correct (ingress would otherwise force /api prefix). No regression.
models.Product.image_url is non-Optional; combined with role check after validation this surfaces a 422 instead of 403 for non-business users. Cosmetic only.

Frontend admin alerts feature: enable sound via [data-testid=admin-sound-toggle-btn], then any new order created (anywhere) triggers within ~7s a toast 'Nuevo pedido recibido' and an [data-testid=alert-item-order] entry in [data-testid=admin-alerts].
